title: Interpreting Social Bias in LVLMs via Information Flow Analysis and Multi-Round Dialogue Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Information flow analysis to identify high-contribution image tokens during neutral reasoning, combined with a multi-round dialogue evaluation to quantify reliance on sensitive visual features, and textual sensitivity bias (TSB) analysis using cosine similarity of intermediate layer embeddings.
